feedback: The coding assignments were challenging but very rewarding. I learned a lot about algorithms.
I found the midterm to be much harder than the practice exams provided.
The teaching assistant was extremely helpful during office hours.
The lecture slides are sometimes a bit cluttered and hard to follow.
I really enjoyed the group project; it helped me understand real-world collaboration.
The lab equipment is outdated and sometimes doesn't work properly.
The professor explains complex concepts in a very understandable way.
The textbook is too expensive and we barely used it this semester.
I wish there were more examples of the coding concepts during lectures.
The online portal is intuitive and makes submitting assignments easy.
Feedback on assignments takes too long to be returned.
The guest lecture on machine learning was the highlight of the semester.
I struggled with the pace of the course; it felt a bit rushed towards the end.
The library has great resources for researching our final papers.
The prerequisite requirements didn't fully prepare me for this level of math.
I love the hands-on approach of the weekly lab sessions.
The classroom is often too cold, making it hard to focus.
The discussion forums are a great place to get quick answers from peers.
The final exam was fair and covered the material we studied.
I think the weighting of the homework assignments is too high.
Great introduction to Python for students who haven't coded before.
The rubrics for the essays are vague and hard to interpret.
Excellent support for students with disabilities in this class.
The coffee machine in the student lounge is always broken.
The overall course structure is very logical and easy to follow.
